title: Headless Strictly Business (MS13, TTW 3.4): from Grouse's job to the four targets enslaved in Paradise Falls (stage 200)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10) [observed]. MS13 is Start Game Enabled [observed]; the player starts it at Grouse, the slaver at the gate of Paradise Falls.

Path (the slavers' side; the quest has no other): Grouse at the gate, asked how to get in, offers the job (MS13Hook11b: stage 1 gives the Mesmetron, its cells, one collar and the four targets' objectives); each target is stunned with the Mesmetron, collared in dialogue (MS13Mezzed2 puts on MS13Collar; MS13Collar1 sends them off) and walks to Paradise Falls (the collar's effect sets XArrived when they reach ParadiseFallsZone, or fakes the arrival when they unload); Grouse's greeting for each arrival pays, gives the next collar and sets its stage (10 Arkansas, 20 Susan Lancaster, 30 Red, 40 Flak); each sets its 'dealt with' stage (15/25/35/45), and the last of those sets 200 (all objectives complete). Killing a target (11/21/31/41) counts too; the fail is all four dead (250). [observed: MS13, MS13Slaves stage, INFO and effect scripts on the TTW load order]

Stand-in for the walk to Arkansas (the sniper at Minefield) and the Mesmetron shot: a headless hit with WeapMesmetron does not apply the weapon's enchantment (the target stays out of MS13MezzedFaction) [observed], so the mez spell is cast on the target instead (CastImmediateOnSelf MS13MezzedSpell: its MS13MezzedScript adds the target to MS13MezzedFaction). The pilot should shoot the Mesmetron itself.

Stand-in for the walk back to Paradise Falls; Arkansas gets there ahead of the player (the collar's effect moves them to the slave house once out of the player's cell and sets ArkansasArrived). Grouse's greeting for the arrival pays, gives another collar and sets 10.

Stand-in for the walk to Susan Lancaster (in Tenpenny Tower) and the Mesmetron shot: a headless hit with WeapMesmetron does not apply the weapon's enchantment (the target stays out of MS13MezzedFaction) [observed], so the mez spell is cast on the target instead (CastImmediateOnSelf MS13MezzedSpell: its MS13MezzedScript adds the target to MS13MezzedFaction). The pilot should shoot the Mesmetron itself.

Stand-in for the walk back to Paradise Falls; Susan Lancaster gets there ahead of the player (the collar's effect moves them to the slave house once out of the player's cell and sets SusanArrived). Grouse's greeting for the arrival pays, gives another collar and sets 20.

The pilot should shoot the Mesmetron itself.

Stand-in for the walk back to Paradise Falls; Red gets there ahead of the player (the collar's effect moves them to the slave house once out of the player's cell and sets RedArrived). Grouse's greeting for the arrival pays, gives another collar and sets 30.
